arguments.command:
cd /workspace/scratch && timeout 170 python3 -c "
import sys, random, time
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/scratch'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
import gen, ref, analyze
for i in range(8):
    rng = random.Random(100+i)
    req = gen.gen(rng,'multi')
    t0=time.time()
    inst = analyze._parse_request(req)
    r,stats = ref.ref_analyze(inst)
    t1=time.time()
    m = analyze.analyze(inst, req['id'])
    t2=time.time()
    print(i, 'ref %.2f mine %.2f' % (t1-t0, t2-t1), m.get('status'), m.get('min_faults'), stats['count'] if stats else '')
" 2>&1 | tail -12
